faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes V200 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year and generation. The original W638 (1996–2003) used the OM601 or OM602. The current W447 generation started with the OM651 (2.1L) from 2014, and switched to the newer OM654 (2.0L) with the 2025 refresh — a completely different engine. Send us your registration and we'll confirm which one your van has.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes V200 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for all engine codes. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my V200?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the OM601, OM602, OM651 or OM654 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM601/OM602 V200 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes — these older units are now out of production, but we continue to rebuild them for every W638 V200 still on the road.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild OM651 V200 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace injector seals, timing chain components and gaskets as standard on every OM651 rebuild where wear is found.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild OM654 V200 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. The OM654 is the current engine fitted from the 2025 refresh, and we service it to the same standard as our other V200 rebuilds.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used V200 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my V200 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a V200 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most V200 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
